customers.evidence: We can create more extraordinary experiences for our customers and that will move us forward.

result.analyst_notes: Brief page dominated by a customer testimonial and site navigation. Customer focus is the only substantive value, framed through a partner's quoted voice rather than the company's own first-person commitment. Other items are calls to action or chrome: 'Join the community' is an event prompt, and 'Focusing on customers has its rewards' is an awards link. No hedged or absolute commitments are stated by the company itself.
